The verifier checks a single corrects_jrnl_no group, so the 2461 reversal lines I added to the 2460 group left the group unbalanced against the original. The instruction says to void only one copy per duplicate and to reverse the journal of the voided copy. This finding contains two duplicate pairs, but a single correction can reference only one journal.

I'll fix the finding for 2460 only. I'll void invoice 801 and reverse every line of journal 2460 in open period 11.

Rejected attempt 1 voided both 801 and 802, and the verifier complained only about the journal group, so the group for 2460 must net to zero on its own. Including 2461's lines broke it. The correction therefore covers 2460 only.

arguments.reasoning: Invoice 801 duplicates invoice 557 (same vendor, trimmed invoice number, amount and date). Neither is paid, so the earlier-entered original (557) is kept and only 801 is voided. Journal 2460 recorded 801 (Dr 5100 / Cr 2000, 1245.08); I reverse every line in open period 11 (Dr 2000 / Cr 5100, 1245.08), so the 2460 group nets to zero on each account. The same reasoning applies to the 802 / 2461 duplicate of invoice 28, but a correction can reference only one journal and my earlier attempt to cover both in a single 2460 group failed. That pair (void 802, reverse journal 2461) needs its own correction referencing 2461.
